warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0074; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: “This is my house” and “That is your house” are natural ownership-identification sentences.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: خانه directly matches the selected dwelling sense of house.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The Lesson adds one concrete noun while reusing familiar demonstratives and possessives.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast the target with a nearby earlier response or a clearly unrelated familiar sentence without creating a second plausible answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Pointing to houses on a neighborhood map is a plausible walking-group interaction.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances remain short, reuse established A1 language, and add only the bounded target planned for this Lesson.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The walking-group arc returns five Lessons after 0069 and rotates the learner role from Sara to Ruby.

transferQuality.evidence: The second response changes demonstrative and possessor while preserving house.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue, activities, retrieval task, and stated outcome all point to the same bounded learning goal.

learnerExperience.evidence: This is model/editor review only; no real learner test is claimed, so learner-experience confidence is deliberately limited.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
The review is limited to the bounded A1 outcome and does not claim broad mastery of the target word or grammar.
Final generated audio prosody is not evaluated in this text-stage review.
resolvedFindings: English target usage is contextually plausible for the authored scene.
Persian copy preserves the intended bounded meaning without adding a second target.
The final activity requires hidden retrieval in a changed controlled context.
Story-arc spacing and learner-role variation were checked against the recent canonical sequence.
